(() => {
  const result = {};
  const make = (html) => {
    const node = document.createElement('div');
    node.style.cssText = 'font:16px/20px serif;width:120px';
    node.innerHTML = html;
    document.body.append(node);
    return node;
  };
  const same = (a,b) => {
    const left = a.getBoundingClientRect();
    const right = b.getBoundingClientRect();
    return Math.abs(left.width-right.width)<0.01 && Math.abs(left.height-right.height)<0.01;
  };
  const plain = make('AVATAR alpha beta gamma delta');
  for (const tag of ['span','a','label','abbr']) {
    for (const value of ['baseline','initial','unset','revert']) {
      const node = make('A<'+tag+' style="vertical-align:'+value+'">VATAR alpha beta gamma</'+tag+'> delta');
      result[tag+'-'+value] = same(node,plain);
      node.remove();
    }
  }
  const sheet = document.createElement('style');
  sheet.textContent = '.baseline-wrapper span{vertical-align:baseline}';
  document.head.append(sheet);
  const nested = make('A<span>VATAR alpha <span>beta gamma</span></span> delta');
  nested.className = 'baseline-wrapper';
  result.nested = same(nested,plain);
  sheet.textContent = '.baseline-wrapper span{vertical-align:initial}';
  nested.style.width = '80px';
  plain.style.width = '80px';
  result.mutation = same(nested,plain);
  sheet.remove();
  nested.remove();
  plain.remove();
  return result;
})()
